targets.rawSql: SELECT a.name AS area_name, a.description AS area_description, l.name AS location_name, l.address FROM public.area a JOIN public.location l ON a.location_id = l.id;
SELECT d.name AS ds_instance_name, d.mq_topic FROM public.ds_instance d;
SELECT c.name AS camera_name, c.stream_url, d.name AS ds_instance_name FROM public.camera c JOIN public.ds_instance d ON c.ds_instance_id = d.id;
SELECT o.timestamp, o.occupancy_count, c.name AS camera_name FROM public.occupancy o JOIN public.camera c ON o.camera_id = c.id;
